items.lede: Microsoft is officially announcing its new Xbox Mythic Achievements today, and they're already available for Xbox Insiders to test. Mythic Achievements work a lot like Sony's PlayStation Platinum trophies and are unlocked once you've earned every original achievement for a game. "Mythic Achievements have already been added to eligible games you completed in the past, […]
items.title: Xbox’s Mythic Achievements are here and they’re just like PlayStation Platinum trophies

items.lede: They signal to the world that someone has fully completed a game. And they apply retroactively to titles you've already finished.
items.title: Xbox just unveiled Mythic Achievements, which are basically PlayStation platinum trophies
